figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Structural overview of NaV1.7 in complex with TTX (1) and auxiliary β-subunits (PDB entry 6J8I). On the left, the whole complex is shown:
the α-subunit (grey surface), along with the auxiliary β-subunits (ribbons). The organization of the α-subunit into four segments is illustrated in the
middle. Each segment consists of a voltage-sensing domain and a pore-forming domain, where the latter is located in the center of the α-subunit. On
the right, the binding site of TTX (1) is shown with key residues for ligand binding. The residues of the DEKA motif are in bold and underlined. The
top depiction highlights the transmembrane view, and the bottom depiction highlights the extracellular view.
